title: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Shepherding The Flock While In Babylon

sense.text:
Our leadership begins by bringing the scriptures to clamp the evil mouths of the simple. We have to shut down simplicity and evil whenever it comes up, and that is what this verse is about: shutting down evil against the Most High’s program.

“Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught”: we’re not going to hold our tongue. Holding fast means holding tight to the faithful word as we have been taught. We’ve been taught how to deliver the most hard words, how to deliver the message to the people to heal them, to resurrect them, to rejuvenate them, and we have to teach that in all faithfulness.

“That he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers”: sound doctrine is the doctrine of the Most High, the doctrine from God. Weak doctrine ain’t gonna be able to set the tone; sound doctrine is how we exhort and how we move in this earth. Our job is to convince the gainsayers, to convince everyone. There is no turning down this gospel. It has got to go out through the whole planet earth; it has to bend minds, bend spirits, break knees, because this is the rock that’s going to smash everything down. So we can’t be soft with it; we got to bring it out as thus saith the Lord.

In other words, shut everybody down: you bend to the will of this Bible or you’ll be dead. That’s what the Most High is basically saying. There’s no ifs, ands or buts about it; the Most High’s program is going to flow regardless of how anybody feels about it.

“For there are many unruly”: this is the negro here. “And vain talkers”: lips of no value. Their own thoughts mean nothing, their own feelings mean nothing; it’s vain because it’s their vain thoughts going up against God’s sound doctrine, and there’s no comparison. “And deceivers”: that is what they are.

Here’s the question: how in the world, after reading the Bible, are you going to be deceived by a vain talker? You see anything posted anywhere, somebody trying to put a thought in your ear and in your mind, and you’ve got the same brains to recognize what’s in the Bible. You’ve got the sound doctrine that tells you how things ought to be, yet you allow some slick talker, some deceiver, some vain imagination person to say something and then you’re deceived.

That’s where the shepherds come in. The job of a shepherd is to guide you away from the wolf, away from the vain talker, away from the deceiver, away from the persons looking to destroy you, your family and your nation, even though they’re black, so-called black folks, because their mind is not on the Most High. Their mind is after the oppressor, and if the mind is after the oppressor you might as well be dealing with the oppressor yourself.

“Specially they of the circumcision”: now we get to it. The circumcision in this chapter would be the Pharisees, people that call themselves the authority on God, the authority on the Bible, the Pharisees, the Sadducees and so forth, the ones saying, if you’re going to learn the doctrine you got to come to us. Today that translates to the quote-unquote organized religions and philosophies, the people with the big town churches and mega churches, and the so-called apologetics. They want to be called apologists; we purposely call them apologetics, anything except what they want to be called, because we have no respect for them. That’s not being vulgar or vicious; we just don’t have time to play when it comes to the word of the Most High. We’ve got a nation to rebuild through Christ, to teach order and direction. They are the quote-unquote authority on religion.

“Whose mouths must be stopped”: you stop these mouths with the word of God. When they put out the vain talk and the lies, you go into the Bible and shut them down, because what they’re talking is not the Most High. If you are simple enough to be deceived by that, you weren’t in the Bible in the first place, and that’s what these people look for.

“Who subvert whole houses”: whole houses follow these people, like in some of these churches. Thank God a whole lot of them are leaving in droves now, because the Most High is waking them up. A lot of them are questioning the foolishness they’ve been learning, which is a good thing, and those teachers’ mouths are being stopped and they’re getting very upset, rightfully so.

“Teaching things which they ought not”: they’re teaching lies and not what’s written in the Bible. “For filthy lucre’s sake”: that’s the reason they do it. They’re looking to make merchandise of the people. They know the Bible doesn’t say the things they’re teaching, but they have an animus, an animosity against the Bible, so they say things thinking you’re not going to check it out, and they hope to appeal to your emotion.

This is another part of the spiritual war we must fight against these sellout negroes. A so-called apologist, a black woman, had the nerve to bump her gums about IUIC and post that ‘IUIC teaches men to leave their wives if they don’t become members’, ‘but they claim to be uplifting the black community.’ Somebody might read that and give it some credence. She’s speaking against the Bible and against the program of the Most High. She should have never said nothing, but now she’s gonna get it.

precepts.why:
This is the sound doctrine. “Every word of God is pure”: this is the pure doctrine on the planet earth, and it can’t be gainsaid. “He is a shield unto them that put their trust in him”: the words are the Most High’s words and they represent him. He is a shield, a protector, to those who put their trust in the words of God.

So with that being the case we don’t slow it down and we don’t bend it. We bring it out just the way the Most High said do it, because at the end of the day we’re rolling with the Most High, not with anybody else, not to help your feelings.

“Add thou not unto his words”: don’t make stuff up. You don’t put your own emotions in the Bible, your own feelings, your own lusts, your own temptations. “Lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.” That is what we do today: shut mouths up, bring the lies to the forefront and smash them.

sense.text: If a man is in the scriptures and in a congregation, his wife is supposed to be in the congregation with him. “Even so must their wives be grave”: grave meaning serious. “Not slanderers”: not evil doers, not the vain talkers, not deceivers, not unruly like we were reading in Titus. “Sober”: she knows what she’s into; she’s with her husband, because that’s how they’re married. “Faithful in all things”: in all the commandments of the Lord, faithful in the order of Corinthians 11, God over Christ, Christ over man, man over woman.

“Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.” That’s the kind of family the Bible is talking about. The deacons must be grave, having their whole houses in order, and if the wife and the whole house is in order, ain’t nobody leaving nowhere. But if they’re out of order, you got to go. That ain’t IUIC, that’s the Bible.

So go back to the madness that IUIC teaches men to leave their wives if they don’t become members: it is wives who choose not to be grave, who choose not to follow their husbands. And they say we break up marriages? Look at what kind of marriages are out there in society. You don’t even have to turn on your TV; just go outside: whoremongering, adultery, children born out of wedlock, no marriage, nothing but wickedness. That woman says nothing about that, because her objective is to stop this truth, and the Most High is gonna stop her. They figure the people ain’t reading this, and they put it out as an emotional feeler, and some people like what she said, and it has nothing to do with the Bible.

We are men who follow this book. That’s the kind of men the Most High is raising up, and that’s what it takes to be a shepherd in this truth: you can’t be emotional, can’t get easily sidetracked, can’t be playing games with people.

“Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.” He brought a sword, and what do you do with a sword? That’s division and death.

What this shows is that these people ain’t about Jesus at all and they’re not about the Bible at all. The Most High is about order, about structure, about family. Just like we read in Timothy, he is about ordering the house right: the women in order, the kids in order, the sons, everybody in order. If you’re not going to be in order, you’ve got to go. That’s the Most High saying that in the scriptures.

“For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.” Christ came to set a man at variance. Are you telling me this woman didn’t read this? But she’ll post something because people won’t go to the Bible; they’ll follow emotional stupidity.

What is actually causing this division is the commandments. It ain’t that the man is laying hands on anyone; he just said these laws are gonna be followed. It’s like when people lose their jobs: the job didn’t put hands on them. The rules went a particular way, you didn’t do it, so you’re out and you ain’t getting a paycheck no more. You’re still coming in looking for a paycheck, and they say we got no paycheck for you because you don’t want to do the job. Nobody has to do nothing; you walk out.

“And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household. He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.” This is Jesus Christ talking, and he is very direct, very austere. If you put anybody above his commandments you are not worthy of him, and you’re not going to get the kingdom. There’s no ifs, ands or buts about it.

precepts.why:
If the unbeliever departs, let him go. “But if the unbelieving depart”: why would the unbelieving depart? They say IUIC does this. Everybody here is supposed to already know what these scriptures say, but there are people watching online who might not understand, so we bring it out.

“Let him depart”, or her. “A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases.” If you have a brother that’s serious about the laws of the Most High, why would the spouse leave? Not because IUIC told them they had to go. They leave because the man says this is the way the house is gonna roll, and you’re not putting up with the bs. Woman, you’re not going to come in here with them doggone pants on, when the Bible says a woman shall not dress like a man; that’s the law. You ain’t gonna put your hands on her, nothing like that, but you say these laws are gonna be followed.

So she has a choice to make: I’m either gonna follow what my husband says or I’m leaving. They leave because the laws of God are being put in effect. It’s not like you put them out; they leave you when you tell them they’re not gonna serve Christmas. You bring the Christmas tree in the house, I’m throwing the tree out. You bring in the Halloween this and that, I’m throwing it out. You bring the Easter bunny, I’m throwing it out. A woman comes in the house with pants, I’m cutting them up and throwing them out. So you will leave, because you don’t want to follow the scriptures. Joshua said for him and his house they were going to serve the Lord; all of them had to follow what the Most High said. And of Abraham it is written that he will command his house. That is what the Most High is requiring of us, so this woman is crazy.

sense.text:
“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers.” This wife who says IUIC breaks up families is an unbeliever. She’s satan, that’s what she is; we’re going to call it like it is. She’s satanic as hell, and she hates the Bible, all of what we’ve just been reading.

When we roll in here we want to know that you believe this. You come in here with some other doctrine, you got to go. If you’re not willing to conform and dance to the tune that we’re bringing out of this Bible, there’s the door. That’s how it’s got to be in everything you do as men, as shepherds: you can’t let somebody come in and steer the ship away from you.

“For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness?” What fellowship has an unbelieving wife with a believing husband? What fellowship have unbelieving children with believing parents, or the other way around? Christ is the one saying this. “And what communion hath light with darkness?” Communion is agreement, conversation: what kind of conversation can I have with people that don’t talk this Bible, that don’t talk these commandments? I can’t commune with those.

“And what concord hath Christ with Belial?” What concord does Christ have with satan? “Or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?” If one in the household is a believer, the other person is an infidel, and how are you going to have a peace accord with them? Christ is breaking that up. That’s why he said he was bringing a sword, to make sure he breaks that up, and that’s why the word says a brother or a sister is not under bondage in those cases. That’s God’s words.

“And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God.” This is the difference: you are the children of the Most High, you are the temple of the living God, and everybody else is considered the dead. You are not to defile yourself with them. If they don’t want to repent, leave them be until they get some sense, because if you continue to hang around that thing, that corruption is going to poison you.

“As God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them.” God is not going to walk with us if we are connected with evil, if we are entertaining evil and sin. You have to clean all of that out in order for the spirit of the Most High to work with you. “And I will be their God, and they shall be my people”: we shall be the people of the Most High.

“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate.” Wherefore means: being that you understood all of what was just read, this is the final conclusion. With that knowledge, come out from among them. So who’s the real separatist here? Who’s doing the separating? The Most High, because he doesn’t want his holy people defiled with evil and wickedness. And if that spouse can’t get themselves in order, the scriptures say if she will not go as you would have her to go, give her a bill of divorce and cut her ass off. That’s the Bible, that’s the scriptures.

“Saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing.” The unclean thing is the unbelievers, the vain talkers, the ones trying to subvert whole houses. That’s the filth it’s talking about.

“And I will receive you.” When that woman or that man walks away because they are unbelievers, the Most High will receive you. He’ll give you what you deserve: that righteous wife, that righteous husband. But you have to have faith to believe that. Don’t hang on to a scorpion. Let that thing go, and get you some new music.

precepts.why:
It’s said that we break up families. We’re pretty clear on whether we do that: we are about marriage, about healthy marriages, counseling, the whole thing, and we do our best to make sure the marriages stay together so the kids can grow up with husband and wife ruling the house properly. But hear what Christ said in that Bible: “If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.”

Hate there means you don’t take your father’s word above Christ. You don’t choose your father’s ways above his ways, you don’t choose your mother’s ways above his ways, and you don’t choose your wife’s ways above him. So what we were looking at earlier, that wife saying she’s running all of that, is out of order with the Most High, and her husband is allowing her to run the house. The Most High says it is for you to deal with it. And you call that uplifting the black community? You stupid as hell.

It means you don’t choose any of them. The kids tell you they want to celebrate Christmas: no. Easter, Saint Patrick’s Day, Halloween: no.

“And brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also”: that part is even heavier, because some of our people still got the negro mind, and they think that that’s really them. The mind we’ve been made to inhabit in this system makes us hate our own salvation, and you got to shut that down. Your own mind could be against Christ. A lot of us, when we first came in here, beat the first few steps: unbelieving parents, unbelieving sons, daughters, wives, husbands. You made it past that and made it here, but then the real question comes up: what about the negro that’s still in you? That’s the real one, and that’s the reason why Christ saved that one last. We usually do a good job of telling people I’m not following that no more, I’m not dealing with this anymore, but when you are home alone with your own thoughts you got to correct that too, and that’s where the hard thing comes. If you can’t do all of those plus your own self, you ain’t ready to get this salvation Christ is bringing down. As shepherds we’re trying to help us get there.

“He cannot be my disciple.” Picture Christ at a military recruiting station, telling you what’s required to get inside his military: you can’t take the ways of your wife above what we’re doing here in this military, you can’t take the ways of your sons, your daughters, your children. If you’re going to do that, leave: you cannot join my military.

sense.text:
We’re talking about the black community. “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” The Most High said for us to gather together, and he ain’t talking about gathering believers and unbelievers. The nation not desired is the nation of Israel that knows they are to repent for their sins and come together underneath God’s commandments. The Most High is trying to gather that together. So no, we’re not about separation per se; we’re about gathering and putting the nation together. But if you’re not going to be right, hit the door.

He’s not giving us a choice. We read this sometimes and don’t realize he’s not asking in that first verse. “Gather yourselves together” is a clear statement, it is in order, it is a directive.

“Before the decree bring forth”: before he brings the judgment for not coming together. “Before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you.” The fierce anger of the Lord is the destruction that the Lord is going to bring down here.

Isaiah 13 is read to show the fierce anger of the Lord in Zephaniah 2. “The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.” When we bring this word out, the nation is going to be mad. The evil people in our community, black men, black women, are going to be mad, and they’re going to try to bring evil and violence towards us for bringing it out. That is the burden, and it goes along with what Ezekiel reads about that burden.

“Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain.” The banner is the Bible, and that’s what this world don’t want to hear. While we are being persecuted, and it’s starting off with talk now, while we’re bringing this word out, the Most High says lift this Bible up, in opposition to all mouths, because all mouths must be stopped.

“Exalt the voice unto them”: when you’re exalting your voice at them you’re not being nice, you’re telling them straight up. “Shake the hand”: you’re telling them off, and they don’t want to hear you when you bring that Bible out there like that and shake your hand at them. “That they may go into the gates of the nobles”: they go and complain and want to stop this. They get on Facebook, get on TikTok, run to these preachers, TD Jakes and all the rest of them, and try to get laws passed to stop this truth.

“I have commanded my sanctified ones.” The sanctified ones are the Israelite prophets, and another word is shepherds: you’re the shepherds being groomed right here in the midst of Babylon the great. The sanctified ones are cleaned up through the laws of the Most High. The laws are what cleaned up the negro, cleaned up the black woman, cleaned up the black man, cleaned up the children.

“I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger.” The mighty ones are the angels, called to back up what the sanctified ones bring out. “Even them that rejoice in my highness”: the angels rejoice in the Most High’s highness.

“The noise of a multitude in the mountains” is the noise of the governments arguing: Putin arguing with Biden, and they got to deal with Macron and that mess over there in Ukraine, talking about getting weapons and blowing each other up. The noise is argument. “Like as of a great people”: there’s a whole lot of nations involved in this. “A tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together”: turn on the news and listen to how these nations are arguing back and forth. That’s the tumult.

“The Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.” That’s the part: the Lord of hosts is the one instigating the fight. He’s causing the nations to get angry. He’s making Putin go down there into Ukraine, he’s shaking up the nations, making problems and causing insurrections and skirmishes between them, setting things ablaze. The Most High is bringing this.

“They come from a far country, from the end of heaven”: they, the missiles, the terrorists. “Even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation”: the Lord is bringing the weapons of his righteous judgment. And what is the purpose of these weapons? “To destroy the whole land.” That’s the day the Most High is trying to get us together to prevent.

Back to Zephaniah after Isaiah 13, because this is what we were reading about. “Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff”: before I destroy the whole land. So what does he tell us to do? Gather ourselves together.

We’ve been going over a lot of prophecy, a lot of the anger going on between the nations over the past few weeks. Brothers have been going through deep scriptures, bringing out all that information about Putin and Biden and Macron and all that madness going on in Ukraine, getting weapons. The Most High is causing that to happen. “Before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”: the Most High wants us to gather ourselves together first, before he brings the destruction.

So why would the Most High tell us to gather ourselves together and to separate at the same time? Because those you’d be uniting with are not to be yoked with you, but the Most High wants believers to come together. Gather yourselves together so that he can take us up out of here. That’s the point.

Our job as shepherds is to shepherd the flock while we’re here in Babylon. We have to guide the nation of Israel, bring in the brothers and the sisters and organize them so that we can be united properly. There are many offices, many administrations that need to be taken care of, many jobs we have to get done in this body. We are an organized nation.

“Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.” Somebody telling you lies is not a warning. We have to tell you the truth about what’s needed in order to save you.
“When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die”: that’s the warning. If our people don’t change, if they don’t repent, they will surely die.

This is how shepherds are made. If you’re going to be a leader in this truth, you have to go through this. “Eat that thou findest”: the scriptures, the laws. “Eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel”: go speak to the nation of Israel, to the Israelites. As we learn this Bible and these commandments, we know what our people need in order to clean them up from the garbage they’ve learned in Babylon, in Christianity, in Islam and all the rest of these philosophies.
“So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll”: he opened my mind. We learn this Bible in our minds.

“Cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee.” When you learn this Bible, think about it as actual food. When you eat food you chew it, you taste it, then it goes down to your belly and down to your bowels. The nutrients don’t really go to work in your mouth; they have to get into your digestive system, and then people can actually see the benefits of the food you eat. That’s what happens when we eat this Bible, this roll: when we digest these commandments they begin to change us. Fill thy bowels means bring this word down into your actions.

Cause thy belly to eat: what was in your mind is being digested, and now you’re beginning to live what you’ve eaten. Now you’re wearing fringes on your clothing, the woman is coming out of pants, the brother is letting his beard grow, the brother is dealing righteous in the house. But these things come with consequences when you’re dealing with unbelieving people.

“Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.” I took it in my mind, and it was sweet because it was exciting. When you first learn this Bible you’re very excited, you can’t wait to learn more, you’re hungry for it. When you learn that you’re an Israelite, that you’re not just a black man or a black woman but the princes and princesses of God, that’s illuminating. But as you begin to learn these commandments and start to go through the trials, it becomes bitter: now family members are hating you, now your wife don’t want to deal with you no more, now your husband don’t want to deal with you no more, now the kids are acting up because they want to deal with Christmas. All of that is summed up in that verse.
“Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.” When we go speak to the house of Israel, there’s opposition that’s going to come.

precepts.why:
“And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again”: this is John on the isle of Patmos. “Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.” Ezekiel and John are dealing with the same situation.

“Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.” When you first learn this truth, you’re happy about it.

“And I took the little book” and “ate it up”: took it in my mind. “And it was in my mouth sweet as honey”: I’m digesting it now and I’m still loving it, because I have not faced any trials yet, I have not been persecuted yet, I have not had my family turn against me. “And as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter”: as soon as it was eaten, the persecution came, the burden came. Like Ezekiel’s roll, the word is sweet in the mouth and bitter in the belly once you live it among unbelievers.

sense.text: Back to Isaiah after the little book made John’s belly bitter: now you understand why it says this here. “The burden of Babylon”: the burden, the burden. Isaiah is describing that this truth is going to be a burden when you go and pronounce it to the nations, when you pronounce it to your family, when you bring it to your own home. That is the bitterness that comes after the sweetness.

“Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”: the man has to lift the Bible up in his house. We have to lift the Bible up in our marriages, lift the Bible up everywhere we go; we got to push this Bible.

“Exalt the voice unto them”: if they don’t want to get right, you got to exalt the voice unto them until they get angry and either repent or leave. That’s it. Then they’re either going to go to the gates of the nobles, or they’re going to walk out and leave altogether. That’s what happens in here: certain brothers and sisters come in here and want to change how we operate. We lift the Bible up and say this is the way it’s going to be. They don’t want to deal with this truth, there’s the door, and then they want to go to the gates of the nobles to try to shut it down. But they shall not prevail.

We’re still talking about the mission of a shepherd. Our job is to assess the condition of the flock, then provide the road map to lead them. That’s what we’re being groomed to do, and the only way this earth is going to change is that we have to change it.

“The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord”: this is Ezekiel being a prophet, being a shepherd, being a watchman over the nation of Israel, and he has to assess what he sees with the nation. He carried him out in prophecy. The spirit of the Lord showed him where Israel was going to be in the last days. Ezekiel the 37th chapter is talking about us, in this country, today.

“And set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones”: he’s bringing Ezekiel all the way up to the Americas and literally showing him this. He sees the black woman out of order. He sees the black man out of order. He sees drugs, he sees our men locked up in prison, he sees the low self-esteem issues. He sees it all.

“And, behold, there were very many in the open valley”: there were many Israelites in the open valley, the valley of death, which is America. “And, lo, they were very dry”: very, very dry. They had no knowledge, no laws, nothing.

So Ezekiel is looking at this, and now he has to begin the process. Like we as shepherds, we have to diagnose the problem and find out what the problem is.

precepts.why:
“For the leaders of this people cause them to err”: the leaders are these preachers, these churches. They cause our people to err.

“And they that are led of them are destroyed.” They that are led of these preachers are destroyed, because they’re not being fed. That is why the bones in the valley are very dry.

“Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished”. The honourable men are the leaders that are supposed to be feeding these people, the preachers, and they’re empty. They’re famished.

“And their multitude dried up with thirst”: the multitude of the people that’s listening to these preachers, T.D. Jakes and all the rest of them, Creflo Dollar, are dried up because they’re not being fed by the teachers that are supposed to be feeding them. They ain’t feeding our people with nothing but lies. These shepherds are not feeding our people. That’s the reason why they’re coming out of these churches, and the reason why they’re in their sleep.

“Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure”. Because these preachers are not feeding the flock, not shepherding the people, the condition our people are living in is hell. Our people are in hell; that’s the valley of the dry bones again. Because of them not having the knowledge, their condition has gotten worse. That’s what it means that hell hath enlarged herself.

sense.text:
“Stay yourselves, and wonder”. There’s a stability: we have to stabilize ourselves while we’re in this. And at the same time it says “and wonder”. Wonder as a shepherd, as a prophet, as a leader. Wonder means assess the damage. Look at your people, figure out what’s wrong with them, assess the problem. How do you do that? You go into the Bible and you see the people’s condition, and if you find out what the condition of the people is, then you also know what the cure is.

“They are drunken, but not with wine”: the people that are looking to these preachers and these leaders to teach them are drunk, because they’re not being fed. So our people are trying to make their own righteousness out here, and they’re just dying in whole bunches.

“They stagger, but not with strong drink”: that’s Christianity. Christianity is the biggest dope crack pipe ever. Christianity makes you do crazy things. We the shepherds are men, and we’ve got so much work to do to take down Christianity, because that is a hell of a drug. It makes the man weak, and that’s what we’re fighting against.

precepts.why:
What does it mean to stay yourselves? “And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times”. The times we’re in are tumultuous times: times of destruction, times of insurrection, times of famine, times of iniquity abounding. With all this chaos going on, we need something to stabilize us, and that’s where the wisdom and knowledge of the Most High comes in.

His commandments tell us how to gather ourselves together; his commandments tell us how to organize and unite among each other, so that we can stay stabilized during all of this upheaval. There’s a method to our madness. As we organize, as we set programs up, as we set the camps up, as we set up the different departments, there’s meaning to that.

“And strength of salvation”: it shall also be the strength of our salvation, of our deliverance. While everything else is getting torn up and run down, the Most High is going to stabilize us and protect us. But we have to do what he said. We have to come together and learn how to work together as a body, as a nation, and that’s what shepherds are here to do: to set the nation up in order.

We deal with the wonder. “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed”: until we be destroyed, because we are disobedient. “Because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God”: this is the problem. So we found out what caused all this evil. We did not follow the Most High, we did not command our households, we did not apply what he told us.

“To keep his commandments”: not only you, but you have to keep the commandments in your household. We didn’t do this, and that’s how we ended up here in this valley of death.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” So when we look at our people, we see these are the Israelites, and we went into the mess we went into because we broke God’s laws. So what do we do? We have to consult the Maker, the Most High, and undo what got us in trouble in the first place. We broke the commandments of the Lord; now we are to return unto the Lord.

sense.text:
A husband watching the class got upset at what we were bringing out about the man taking his place. What we’re trying to teach is to build houses, to build the black community, and it takes the man taking the front: put your wife and your children in subjection under you, you under Christ, and let’s build this nation. If you don’t do that, then it applies to you. She can’t teach. She ain’t no prophet, she ain’t no priesthood, she ain’t no shepherd. You’re supposed to be the shepherd. This is love that we bring you, brother: you’re going to die if you don’t get it right. You can be mad at us, but if you don’t learn and you fall back with whatever she’s talking about, you will die here in America with her when these bombs drop, when God judges the earth.

Give me what Christ said about those that don’t want him to rule. “But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them”: if you don’t want to follow what he said, if you want to have the woman rule over you, that’s an enemy to Christ. Christ did not set it up that way. Those his enemies are the ones who do not want to accept what he set up out of that Bible; he set up the order.

“Bring hither, and slay them before me.” The Lord is going to have you killed, brother. The Lord will have you put to death. So what we’re bringing out is to save your life.

I’m married now 27 years to the same woman, all my kids with the same woman. I take care of my wife; she ain’t never one day been out there to go look for a dollar. I’ve always maintained my household, and the church ain’t take care of me. So I ain’t soft and cuddly on the inside. This ain’t no acting. We want to see all people repent, but we ain’t with the weak man foolishness. We pray you repent, but if not, it is what it is.

precepts.why:
Let’s see what Christ set up. “But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ”: that’s why, if you don’t want to follow Christ, you’re going to face the judgment. The head of every man is Christ, not your woman, not your wife, brother.

“And the head of the woman is the man”: the head of your wife is you. Your head, not the other way around. Christ set that up; that’s Christ’s rule. So those that would not that he should reign over them are those that reject this order.

This is the reason why we did what we just did. “When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die”: that’s what we were reading, that thou shalt surely die if you continue not to follow what Christ said. If you want to disregard what Christ said, call it anything you want to call it, you’ve got to deal with this here.

“And thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life”: trying to save your life, brother. You don’t realize we’re your best friend. “The same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.” If we don’t tell you, your blood is on our hands. We’re not telling you this for whatever ulterior motive you think we’ve got; we’re telling you so that your blood won’t be on our hands.

“Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness”: that’s what we did, and that’s what’s happening here. He doesn’t want to hear what we’re saying, wants to call it all kinds of BS, and he’s going to pay for that. He’s being marked and warned today. You’re going to allow your woman to get up there and say something like that, and you and your whole house are going to catch hell for that. “Nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity”: you shall die in your sins, because what you’re doing is a sin.

“But thou hast delivered thy soul.” We delivered our soul because we told you what the law was. We’re not grandstanding; we’re telling you what needs to be done so that you don’t die. That’s what a shepherd’s supposed to do.

sense.text: “They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink”: this is what we just got through dealing with. They stagger on Christianity and foolishness.

“For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep”. What we’ve been reading is sound doctrine; why would somebody have a problem with this? Where you misunderstand what we’re bringing out, that’s deep sleep. We read what Christ said. We read what Paul said; Paul said be followers of me as I am of Christ, and he’s given you the order. Then Christ said, if you don’t obey that order, bring him in front of me and kill him. Then we read the reason why we’re bringing it out to you: we don’t want your blood on our hands. And you’re still asleep, still arguing with us.

“And hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.” The prophets are your teachers, your preachers, your apologetic madness. The Most High closed all your eyes; you can’t even see which way is up. You call bitter sweet and sweet bitter. Here we’re trying to give you the knowledge to help you and your whole family, and you’re going to speak against it. You’re going to pay for that, so you better repent.

This is what Christianity has done to the negro. A negro preacher in a church somewhere is pictured praying for Ukraine, while black people in Ukraine are catching complete hell over there. They won’t even let them get on the train, calling them every name and all kind of craziness, and yet you’re going to pray for Ukraine while your people over here are catching complete hell. Somalia was bombed. When the Haitians walked hundreds of miles and got to the border, they had them chasing them with horses; nobody prayed for them. America continues killing people in Africa; nobody prays for them. But you’re going to pray for the white people over there. That’s how stupid we are. Christianity is the worst crack. It makes women out of men; it just castrates them.

What should we be praying for, war or peace? Any time you’re praying, you’re supposed to be praying for war. If you’re praying for peace, something’s wrong with you; you are going against God, because of what God says is going to happen on this earth.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”: the Bible says there are going to be wars, and there are going to be rumours of wars.

“For nation shall rise against nation”: God says nations are going to rise up against nations. This is Bible prophecy. So for us or anybody to say we don’t want nations to fight against nations, we don’t want war to happen, you are going against what God says is going to happen.

So we are praying for war, and praying for more war to happen, because the Bible said kingdom shall fight against kingdom and nations against nations. That’s what we want. We don’t want no peace.

Going on what the deacon just said. “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: our people fell by the edge of the sword and were put to death, not only from 70 A.D., but even on the slave ships, the terrible things that happened to us in slavery, the terrible things that happen to us in the black community. People are being shot down in the street illegally, unjustly; dope is being pushed to us; our people are suffering from low self-esteem and all kinds of evils that we do to one another, because of a sick mind we’ve been programmed to have in Babylon the Great. How come nobody’s praying for them?

The negro was made to worship white folks and to be against his own. He has no respect for his own self. You’re praying for people that hate you, that are tearing your people up? You’re praying for Ukraine, where the people are being snatched off the buses, while Somalia was bombed and he ain’t got nothing to say. Christ marveled at unbelief; the negro would make Christ marvel. Christ made the heavens, the stars, everything, and then all of a sudden the negro popped up, and the only reaction is: what is this? How in the world are you going to go pray for your enemy while your own people are destroyed, and it doesn’t bother you, and you allow yourself to be photographed for the world to see and think nothing’s wrong with it? That’s some serious mental sickness.

“And shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”. Our homeland is being run over by Esau calling himself a Jew. How come he’s got nothing to say against that? Where’s the outcry? He’s going to pray for Ukraine. Our people are sick.

“Until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: until their time is up. When their time of rulership is up, this is how it’s going to start to go down.

“And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring”. These are the kind of scriptures the church people don’t like.

This is the time period of what Christ said: think not that I’ve come to bring peace on earth; I’m bringing a sword. It starts with dividing the righteous from the wicked. He’s going to bind up the wicked and put them in bundles and burn them, and sever the sheep from the goats.

“Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth”: those prophecies of the bombs and all that, Christ coming with the weapons, like we were reading in Isaiah 13, to destroy the whole land. We’re looking for all of that.

“And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.” We’re looking for the Son of man, the Lord Jesus, the black Jesus, to save us from the hands of our enemies and from those that hate us. We’re looking for no peace. We’re looking for the Most High to kill our enemies, redeem us from the hand of those that hate us, and set us back up in power. Anybody in captivity that’s not thinking this way, something’s definitely wrong with you, because you are the victim of every level of hate you can think of.

“And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.” This is what we’re waiting for: our salvation draws near. The Most High has got to bring all of these things into fruition, and this is what we have to go through. These are the beginnings of sorrows, but they must continue, because through much tribulation shall we enter into the kingdom. And it’s going to take shepherds that know this Bible to help you get there.

precepts.why:
When the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled, that’s what you should pray for. We shouldn’t be praying for no peace, because Christ said I ain’t bringing peace. Even when the Lord taught us to pray, thy kingdom come, for his kingdom to come, war, destruction and death have to take place.

“Let the saints be joyful in glory”: the saints are the Israelites, joyful in the kingdom of heaven, and it’s the Most High saying this. “Let them sing aloud upon their beds”: we’re finally going to get some sleep, some rest. The Lord shall give us rest from our sorrow, and from our fear, and from the hard bondage wherein we were made to serve here in this captivity. He’s going to relieve us from that.

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand”. You ain’t bringing peace when you’ve got a twoedged sword. The Most High is saying we’re going to have his high praises in our mouth and a killing instrument in our hand, “To execute vengeance upon the heathen”, upon the nations. We’re going to be happy when this happens.

So like the deacon said, we’re looking for no peace. The only piece we’re looking for is the pieces of people’s heads chopped off with them swords when it’s time for things to go down.

sense.text:
These Christianity preachers are not bringing out this Bible to our people, and our people need this. “The vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed”: the vision of all, what’s in this Bible, is sealed when it comes to these preachers. You got these preachers praying for Ukraine while our people are suffering left and right in all kinds of ways, and the people are not being fed. That’s the reason why they’re leaving the churches.

The reason the preachers are coming up on the set is because they’re feeling the pressure of Christianity being destroyed. That’s why they mention IUIC: they say that’s the culprit, the nemesis of their white supremacy doctrine, Christianity. The negro is saying this; they’re trying to uphold white supremacy, while we’re trying to save our people through the Bible, through the scriptures. They got a problem with us, but they don’t have a problem with the crack dealer.

The negro is a created thing, meaning his mentality, the way we think and the things that we do. Your people are suffering the absolute worst atrocities of all people and you’re praying for somebody else; that cannot come up on its own. He was manufactured in the laboratory, and the Christian church is that laboratory. He was put on that table, that assembly line, and he jumped off the table, ran into society and got on Facebook. He escaped, then the lab burned down: no evidence of his creation. Christianity, that crack is marvelous. And what is kneeling and putting your hand on a screen going to transmit? That’s church. You young ones ain’t falling for that foolishness; that old-time religion stuff, those days are over.

He wants people to follow his example and totally forget about his own people. The atrocities that happened to our northern kingdom brothers, how our Native American brothers were murdered and butchered up and had their lands taken, genocide: nothing to say about that. He wants to talk about Ukraine.

Where are the prayers for the trauma Emmett Till’s mother went through? In 1955 a 14-year-old boy from Chicago went down to Mississippi and allegedly whistled at a white woman, and she got a white mob to pull him out of his relative’s house. She lied. They tied a gin fan to him, shot him, put a hole in his head and threw him in the bottom of the river. His mother, Mamie Till, was trying to get justice for her son. What did her son do to deserve this? Nothing. Forty years of agony waiting for justice, and she finally died with no justice, and there’s hundreds of our mothers feeling like this. They dropped all charges against the woman that did that, and she’s still alive, Carolyn Bryant. Where are the prayers for that? Where are these big-time preachers to deal with stuff like this?

Do you all think there is a God, and that he is just? Even though we ain’t had vengeance yet for what was done, God is not going to allow this to go unpunished. Every evil that Esau has done to our people, he’s gonna pay for it.

In society today, for slavery and all that was done to our forefathers, did anybody pay for it? No, nobody paid for it. When the so-called people that call themselves Jews were put in concentration camps in World War II, did they get vengeance for that? Yeah, they went and hunted down them Nazi criminals and killed them. When 9/11 took place, did they get vengeance? Yeah, America invaded Afghanistan, killed bin Laden and al-Qaeda, and killed hundreds and thousands of people in Iraq and Afghanistan. What about the slaves? Did we ever have vengeance for what was done to us? So this is what God says.

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth”, and a two-edged “sword in their hand”: the Israelites will have two-edged swords in their hand. This is when Esau and the nations are going to get judged for what they did to God’s people.

“To execute vengeance upon the heathen.” Why would we be executing vengeance? Vengeance for slavery, vengeance for what was done to the North American Indians, vengeance for what was done to Emmett Till. That’s what we’re gonna be executing vengeance for. Vengeance for what was done to us when Rome came in and destroyed us, vengeance for what was done to the apostles, and vengeance for what is gonna be done to us in the future.

It says in Deuteronomy there shall be no might in our hands when the nations come against us and destroy us. But when Christ returns, guess what: we’re gonna have the might to take vengeance. When Christ returns we gonna have that power, disappearing and reappearing and cutting those heads off.

precepts.why:
“And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?” These are the saints that are dead already. Right now they are in the heavens, asking God for vengeance: to bring vengeance on Edom and all the nations that are on the earth, on the people that enslaved them and destroyed them over here in America and all the four corners of the earth.

If you are a saint of the Most High, that’s where your mind is supposed to be. You’re supposed to be wanting vengeance, payback, because the Bible prophesied about that.

“If any man have an ear, let him hear. He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”: that’s the payback. All the nations that led our people into slavery are going to go into slavery.

“He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword”: the nations killed us with the sword, and according to Bible prophecy they gonna be killed with the sword. That’s Bible prophecy and it’s gonna come to pass. The Christians read this and they be in la la land, but this right here precepts with Psalms 149.

“Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.” Patience meaning you must be waiting on this. If you ain’t waiting for payback and vengeance, something’s wrong with you; you don’t understand the gospel, because part of the gospel is you getting vengeance for what was done to your people.

sense.text:
“And the great dragon was cast out”: that is what we are basically waiting for. “That old serpent” that deceived the woman back then; this is y’all now: the old serpent, the devil, the white man. “Called the Devil”, he “deceiveth the whole world”, and that was Christianity. That’s why the negro is on his knees crying for Kazaria, for a damn map, praying for them to stop the bombs, but what about the racism and the evil that’s happening to our people over there? They let the dogs go on the bus first; … you come after the dogs. That’s in Ukraine, aka Kazaria, same place.

“He was cast out into the earth”, put into captivity, “and his angels were cast out” with him: all his allies along with him.

“And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation”: now that he’s cast out, now is come salvation. You cannot have salvation with the serpent walking around. He’s got to be cast down first, then you get salvation; the serpent won’t be saving anybody anyway. Now is come salvation because the devil and Satan is cast down. “And strength, and the kingdom of our God”: our God, Israel’s God, “and the power of his Christ”.

“For the accuser of our brethren”, the accuser of our brethren Israel, is cast down, “which accused them before our God day and night.” Every day we get slandered and lied upon by these nations, all the time, before the Lord. He sees it, he hears it, and it will eventually stop.

This goes to that woman, Carolyn Bryant. She’s an accuser: she accused that boy of doing nothing wrong whatsoever. A lie. She’s still alive today and she’ll face no criminal charges whatsoever, but her nation will.

That mother waited three years for justice for her son, shot in the back on video, and got a plea deal. So she said he had better watch his back in jail. That is her frustration talking. When our people feel we can’t get no justice anywhere else, they go underground and say ‘street justice’, take it to the streets. That is what happened in L.A. with the brothers during the Rodney King thing: it was on video, and it was the same foolishness. And the black preacher don’t see nothing wrong with these kinds of situations and never says a word.

Was that sister justified in being angry? Yes. Her son was murdered, shot, and she was justified in being angry. But if you brothers and sisters want vengeance for all the evil being done to your people, you know what you have to do: keep these commandments. Stop lying, stop stealing, stop killing, stop hating each other. You want vengeance, keep the commandments.

“Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you”. To recompense is to pay back: it is a righteous thing with God to pay back tribulation on them that trouble us, them that oppress us and afflict us. All of these judges, all of these lawyers, all of them: the Lord is going to recompense tribulation on them for all that evil they are doing. The nation that eats us up, the Lord is going to recompense tribulation on them for all the evil they have done to us.

“Whose possessors slay them” and “hold themselves not guilty.” Possessors is plural. That is one thing we don’t understand about this nation we live in. You deal with these people, you might have grew up with them, you hear them talking that good stuff, ‘man, I’m with you’, but you have no idea what the majority, or what that friend, is really saying behind closed doors.

In America there is a trend with white people who kill Israelites. For the cop that shot that young man in the back there was a GoFundMe set up, and people wrote that they just saw the story and wanted to help donate. It is immediate within them: they just seen the story and said, I got to help my people out. That’s what Edom does. They’re the possessors and they hold themselves not guilty. This is their people, and they all feel the same way, that he didn’t do nothing.

When the GoFundMe was removed, they went underground. Messages went out to white folks pointing them to an organization raising money for police that kill Israelites, asking for tax deductible donations to support their police. They know they are wrong as hell and they help their people. And here we sit up and want to pretend there’s some good ones. That shows you how organized they are: even underground they were able to network and get that thing going. We got a whole lot of work to do. Pray every day for the destruction of this evil, wicked kingdom.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, “the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. That is those nuclear bombs that the Most High had these scientists to build, and we thank God for that thing. “The earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up”: all the injustices, everything, is going to be set on fire.

The heavens are these kingdoms, America. The great noise is boom, destruction: that is the Lord mustering the host of the battle. The elements melting with fervent heat is hot missile warfare. That day is going to feel like an oven, like the prophet Malachi said.

We have been going over the classes about the bombs and what is going on in Ukraine, and we get excited about that, but we tend not to think about how we deal with each other as brothers and sisters. What would we do if that siren went off and the missiles were coming here? Back in the 80s they said a nuclear weapon fired from Russia takes about 23 minutes to get here; now they say about 30. By the time you hear the alarm, what are you going to do, run all over in chaos? Where are you going to hide? They ain’t even letting the black people on the trains and the buses in Ukraine. Where are we going to go? Our only escape is those chariots.

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”. Now that we see this is about to go down, this is a question for us. Seeing that all these our enemies shall be destroyed and all of the captivity is going to be over, how should we be, knowing this?

This is the reason we have to be organized ourselves, the reason we have to know how to work together: systems, organization, all the things that help us operate like a real nation, in unity. When we set the rules on how to do right with each other and how to organize the nation, the scriptures say to obey them that have the rule over you, for they watch for your souls. That is the shepherdship: shepherding our brothers.

We have a whole nation of people that is going to come through these doors. As this sick world winds down, the Most High is going to start pulling our people out of this dope called Christianity, out of the drug houses, and the brothers and sisters are going to come to get their lives right, and we are going to have to organize all of them. That is a big job. We have to do right by organizing underneath the Most High’s commandments.

precepts.why:
When the day of the Lord comes and the missiles are coming, our only escape is those chariots: Psalms 91. “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day”. That arrow that flies by day is the missile, from the Soviet Union, the thing they’re going to rebuild.

“Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” That destruction is the destruction that is going to come from those bombs. So when that is happening, where are we going to be?

Ukraine ain’t praying for you if Russia fires those missiles over here. They ain’t praying for the negro that can’t get on the bus.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” Why is it not going to come nigh thee? Because we are keeping the commandments. And the physical thing that is going to be happening is the chariots. So if the chariots decide not to pick you up, what are you going to do?

“Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” That means you are going to be looking down from the chariots, seeing the destruction of your enemies, like it says in Revelation: you are going to be watching them die as you’re getting taken up.

Those that disobey what Christ said are not getting taken; they ain’t going nowhere. Like this family, this woman and man speaking against us: it ain’t going to be no game in that day. It’s going to be all right. Good riddance.
